harnessIncidents.what: Halmos default --loop 2 truncates the validator's while(k<5) and 11-entry loops: every path pruned -> [ERROR] 'all paths reverted' on all 5 controls

--loop 12 still too low. Halmos counts per back-edge over the whole path, so the inner f<5 loop over 4 unexecuted swapParams rows (20 visits) is pruned. n=1,2 controls falsely reported [PASS] ('unreachable'), with a loop-bound WARNING. A proof run at loop 12 would have been VACUOUS for 1- and 2-hop routes, the most common live shapes. All results below use --loop 32 and show no loop-bound warning.

proofs.domain: unbounded: token, path[11], swapParams[5][5], pools[5] fully symbolic; precondition path[1]!=0 (validator k>=1; the k==0 case is R0)
proofs.property: if REAL setRoute (6b862aa) does not revert, then on the STORED route with n = Router NG v1.1 executed hop count: (a) path[2n]==rewardToken; (b) every entry after 2n is zero; (c) every executed pool slot path[2h+1]!=0; (d) every executed intermediate token path[2h]!=0 (1<=h<n); (e) every executed row has swapParams[h][2]!=0; (f) every unexecuted swapParams row is all-zero and every unexecuted pools[h] is zero. Router NG therefore delivers rewardToken and hits none of its structural reverts (Bad swap type, call to empty pool, zero token).
proofs.nonVacuity: check_V1_symReachN1..N5 all FAIL with witnesses for n=1,2,3,4,5 (accepted routes of every hop count reachable in this exact domain and loop bound)
proofs.strength: kill-controls: one-line mutants NoGap, NoEnd, NoToken and NoPools all FAIL R1 (check_M1..M4). Every validator clause is load-bearing for this property except the swapParams-row checks (no swapParams mutant was run; see unverified)
proofs.generalityNote: Not an identity: the model (_routerHops) is independent of the validator's own k loop (it breaks on route[2i+3]==0, not on route[2i+1]==0), and the mutants show the property discriminates.

proofs.property: an accepted route with path[1]==0 (validator k==0, which Router NG would still execute as hop 0 and revert on) exists only for token==rewardToken. _sellYield skips token==reward (SYAHarvester.sol L355), so such a route is never sent to the router.

proofs.domain: model-complete equality abstraction: path in {0,R,X,T}^10 x token in {T,R} (2,097,152 paths) joined on k with per-row (swap_type!=0, other!=0) x pools{0,P} (32768 combos per k)
proofs.note: bounded/abstracted evidence. Corroborates R1 but carries no independent proof weight beyond the abstraction.
